items.question: Which plan is right for me?
items.answer: The free plan is ideal for individuals and personal projects. Plus is for professionals and small businesses, Whale for growing teams, and Business for organizations that need maximum performance and security.

items.question: Can I change my plan later?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time from your account settings, and the difference will be calculated automatically.

items.question: What is the difference between monthly and yearly billing?
items.answer: Yearly billing saves you about 20% compared to monthly billing, charged as one payment for the full year.

items.question: Do I need a credit card to get started?
items.answer: No, you can start on the free plan immediately without a card. You only need a payment method when upgrading to a paid plan.

items.question: Do prices include all products?
items.answer: Yes, every plan includes forms, store, links, analytics, and integrations within the limits shown in the comparison table.

items.question: What currency are prices in?
items.answer: All prices are in Iraqi dinar (IQD).
